description: Building Energy Profiles: A Geospatial Dataset for Dublin, Ireland is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Nasim Eslamirad. Central to our investigation is the Building Energy Rating (BER) dataset of Ireland, sourced from GeoDirectory data. This dataset provides a foundational resource, encompassing a range of building-scale parameters such as detailed addresses, geocode data (latitude and longitude), area, height, number of floors, roof type, construction age, radon emission, HVAC system details, and bedroom ... Coverage: national (IE); the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
